_comment: OPT-IN; requires the exolvra-genesis CLI on PATH. The CLI loop has stronger in-memory enforcement. These plugin hooks persist only hashes, modes, and dirty-path metadata, never secret file contents; a builder with write access can tamper with this disk snapshot. PreToolUse snapshots builders, PostToolUse checks immediately, Stop catches an unfinished dispatch. Use run-scoped state.json and genesis-task metadata as documented in commands/run.md.
